# HydroSense Texas

> HydroSense manages device selection, plumbing coordination, installation, setup, shutoff testing, and homeowner handoff in one complete service. Plumbing work is performed through a Texas-licensed plumbing partner under Responsible Master Plumber M-43057.

- [Smart water shutoffs during power or Wi-Fi outages](https://hydrosensetx.com/guides/smart-water-shutoff-power-wifi-outage): Device-specific local behavior, connected features, and backup-power limits

HydroSense standard installation starting prices currently range from $999 to $4,175 by verified incoming domestic-main size. The domestic household water line is the standard scope. Irrigation must be specifically requested and quoted separately. Fire-sprinkler and fire-suppression piping are excluded.

- [Cypress](https://hydrosensetx.com/service-area/cypress): Northwest Houston, median home $340,000

- [Sugar Land](https://hydrosensetx.com/service-area/sugar-land): Fort Bend, median home $440,000

## Service areas — vacation home markets

- [Galveston](https://hydrosensetx.com/service-area/galveston): Beach houses, vacation rentals, salt air corrosion, hurricane exposure, Airbnb/VRBO density
- [Lake Conroe](https://hydrosensetx.com/service-area/lake-conroe): High-end second homes, weekend occupancy, freeze vulnerability, Houston-based owners
- [Lake Livingston](https://hydrosensetx.com/service-area/lake-livingston): Weekend cabins, retirement homes, Piney Woods freeze exposure, Houston/East Texas owners

## Devices we install

- [All devices](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices): Comparison of all five supported device families and how HydroSense chooses
- [Flo by Moen](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices/moen-flo): Broadest insurer acceptance, 1-week learning period
- [Phyn Plus](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices/phyn-plus): Pressure wave analysis, ranked first for leak detection accuracy
- [StreamLabs Control](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices/streamlabs): Ultrasonic flow meter, no internal turbine
- [Guardian by Elexa](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices/guardian): Retrofit, mounts on existing valve, no plumbing replacement
- [FloLogic](https://hydrosensetx.com/devices/flologic): Designated large-line family for qualifying 1.5-inch and 2-inch domestic mains; final compatibility and model are confirmed in writing

- Company: HydroSense Texas, a Lead Ledger Pro LLC brand
- Plumbing authority: Plumbing work is performed through a Texas-licensed plumbing partner under Responsible Master Plumber M-43057.
- Service area: Houston metropolitan area, Greater Houston, Southeast Texas
